title: Six principles for supporting academic freedom in universities
title_zh: 支持高校学术自由的六项原则
abstract: Many academics are concerned about threats to independent enquiry in higher education. Here’s how it can be protected while taking legitimate concerns into account.
abstract_zh: 许多学者担忧高等教育中的独立探究受到威胁。本文阐述了在兼顾合法关切的前提下，如何保护这一权利。
